full_text:
Article 5 (Operation of Subcommittees)
(1) A subcommittee meeting shall be convened in any of the following cases:
1. Where the chairperson of the Committee (hereinafter referred to as the "chairperson") or at least five Committee members request a meeting;
2. Where at least one third of the incumbent members of the subcommittee request a meeting;
3. Where the subcommittee chairperson otherwise deems a meeting necessary.
(2) The subcommittee chairperson shall convene and preside over meetings of the subcommittee.
(3) A subcommittee meeting shall open with the attendance of a majority of its incumbent members and shall adopt resolutions with the affirmative vote of a majority of the members present.
(4) Where necessary to perform duties, the subcommittee chairperson may request relevant administrative officials, officers or employees of producer organizations, farmers or fishers, or other experts to attend a subcommittee meeting and state their opinions.
(5) Article 2 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the preparation of minutes of subcommittee meetings. In such cases, "Committee" shall be construed as "subcommittee", "members" as "subcommittee members", and "results of consultations" as "results of review and coordination".
